description: Replacement of 2no. existing single glazed timber windows with new double glazed uPVC windows to the front elevation, replacement of 1no. existing single glazed timber window with a new double glazed uPVC window to the rear elevation, and replacement of 1no. existing single glazed timber window with a new double glazed uPVC window to the side elevation at ground floor level.
subdivision_of_building: The proposal affects the ground floor (112 Willow Vale) only. The upper floor (114 Willow Vale) is unaffected.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawing numbers, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

Existing and proposed window details rec 24/06/2026.

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.

Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

- Windows ground floor front and rear: Double glazed sash uPVC, colour, and style to match the existing windows to be replaced.

- Windows ground floor side: Double glazed sash uPVC with stained glass windows, colour, and style to match the existing windows to be replaced.

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.  

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC6 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 4 - Prior to the installation of the new windows, details of the manufacturer's specifications shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by the Council.

The development shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the approved details. The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.  

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC6 of the Local Plan (2018).
